summary.en-US: Glass themes and backgrounds for ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, Qwen, Google AI Studio, DeepSeek, and Hugging Face.

description.en-US: Glass themes, image and video backgrounds, fonts, privacy controls, and quick settings for ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, Qwen, Google AI Studio, DeepSeek, and Hugging Face, including HuggingChat. Message queues and model preferences follow native website controls. Preferences and uploaded backgrounds stay in browser storage.

release_notes.en-US: Adds all eight supported websites, shared appearance and privacy controls, message queues, native model preferences, and bundled fonts. Expands Gemini galleries and AI Studio workspaces. Simplifies the settings popup and welcome setup.

version.approval_notes: MIT-licensed browser extension. The XPI contains readable JavaScript and CSS source. The unlimitedStorage permission stores user-selected backgrounds locally within a 15 MB file limit. Website access applies the matching adapter and styles. Copyright and license notices are included in the package.
